objective.en: Take some counters away and find how many are left, within 10.
objective.id: Mengambil beberapa keping dan menemukan berapa yang tersisa, sampai 10.

materials.id: Bingkai sepuluh digital dengan keping yang dicoret

hintLadder.en: Some counters are taken away. How many are left?
hintLadder.id: Beberapa keping diambil. Berapa yang tersisa?

hintLadder.en: The crossed-out counters are gone. Count only the ones that stay.
hintLadder.id: Keping yang dicoret sudah diambil. Hitung hanya yang tersisa.

hintLadder.en: Tap each counter that is left as you count it.
hintLadder.id: Ketuk setiap keping yang tersisa saat menghitungnya.

hintLadder.en: There were {whole}. Count back one step for each counter taken away.
hintLadder.id: Tadinya ada {whole}. Hitung mundur satu langkah untuk setiap keping yang diambil.

hintLadder.en: {whole} take away {part} leaves {missing}. {whole} − {part} = {missing}. Let’s try a new one.
hintLadder.id: {whole} diambil {part} sisa {missing}. {whole} − {part} = {missing}. Ayo coba soal baru.

parentNotes.en: If your child gives the number taken away, cover those objects with your hand and ask what is still on the table.
parentNotes.id: Jika anak menyebut jumlah yang diambil, tutup benda itu dengan tangan dan tanyakan apa yang masih ada di meja.

offlineExtension.en: Snack plate: put up to 10 pieces of fruit on a plate, eat some together, and ask how many are left.
offlineExtension.id: Piring camilan: taruh sampai 10 potong buah di piring, makan beberapa bersama, lalu tanyakan berapa yang tersisa.
